articles.headline: Vanderbilt PG Tyler Tanner withdraws from NBA draft
articles.description: Vanderbilt's Tyler Tanner, one of the elite point guards in the country, told ESPN on Wednesday that he has withdrawn from the NBA draft and will return for his junior season.

articles.headline: Milan Momcilovic withdraws from NBA draft, set for college return
articles.description: Former Iowa State forward Milan Momcilovic, the No. 1 player in the transfer portal, is withdrawing from the NBA draft and will play college basketball next season, his agents told ESPN.

article.story: SAN ANTONIO -- — Sheldon Williams' 22 points and 11 rebounds helped Texas A&M-CC defeat Incarnate Word 79-71 on Saturday. Nick Shogbonyo scored 20 points while going 4 of 9 and 11 of 14 from the free-throw line for the Islanders (11-9, 7-4 Southland Conference). Leo Torbor had 10 points and shot 4 of 7 from the field and 1 of 7 from the free-throw line. Tahj Staveskie finished with 25 points and four assists for the Cardinals (9-11, 4-7). Davion Bailey added 16 points, seven rebounds, two steals and three blocks for Incarnate Word. Harrison Reede finished with 12 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
